title: Each bike is built and then can be finished in any color or style⁠
body_html:
Each bike can be finished in any colour or style. This detail shot proves it: split green and pink on the head tube, orange bearing visible at the bottom bracket.

The colour split runs straight down the centreline. Green on one side, magenta on the other. It shouldn't work; it absolutely does. Boldness that pays off.

Custom finishes transform frames from generic to personal. This builder chose colours that mean something — maybe favourite shades, maybe team colours, maybe pure whimsy. The bike carries that choice forever.

Detail photography like this shows what full-bike shots miss. The precision of the colour divide. The orange accent where bearing meets shell. The gloss finish catching light.

We provide the frame and the process. Builders provide the vision. This vision was distinctive — and executed cleanly.

Your bike can look like anything you want. This one looks like nothing else. 🎨
